name: tracker boundary only checks the authenticated user
rationale: R. `user-1` gives exact `{kind:allow}` without profile dependency. A tracker owner changed to unconditional quiz redirect escapes scan success because that is a different live resolver.

name: tracker boundary fails closed without an authenticated user
rationale: R. Null auth gives exact `/quiz` redirect. Auth throw is a separate catch path and cannot catch a null-specific allow bug.

name: tracker boundary fails closed when the authenticated-user read is unavailable
rationale: R. Rejected auth is converted to exact redirect; deleting tracker catch makes this reject while null case remains green.

name: scan boundary allows an authenticated user with a completed quiz
rationale: R. Existing full profile and explicit null scalp-condition rows both allow. Null scalp-condition is an admitted completed scalp step; treating null as missing blocks a supported quiz result. Tracker does not read diagnostics.

name: scan boundary redirects without an authenticated user
rationale: R. Null user exact redirect before profile resolution; a scan-only guard removal permits complete default profile. Tracker auth has different owner. No no-profile-read claim is made by this callback.

name: scan boundary redirects when the quiz diagnostics are incomplete
rationale: R. Null whole profile redirects. This exercises the `!profile` guard, whereas a populated but invalid profile only tests field predicates; deleting null guard causes a throw which scan catch still redirects, so the stronger retained meaning is denied result for absence, not sensitivity to that private guard.

name: scan boundary redirects when a single quiz field is missing
rationale: R. Preserves all five current rows: absent density, null density, empty chemical-treatment array, null concerns, undefined concerns. All exact `/quiz` redirects. Dropping these validation terms admits malformed stored records; the null-whole-profile test cannot detect that. No new rows proposed.

name: scan boundary fails closed when the authenticated-user read is unavailable
rationale: R. Scan owner catches auth rejection. Tracker's separate catch cannot protect this owner.

name: scan boundary fails closed when the hair-profile read is unavailable
rationale: R. Auth succeeds then profile rejects. An implementation moving profile await outside the protected region fails here while auth-error case remains green.

name: scan page tier: a paid-access composite of 'denied' is free
rationale: R. Real canonical resolver receives denied and derives free. Page-mode overlap injects already-derived free, and composed overlap throws before deriving a denied tier. Both would miss denied→premium regression here. Canonical symbol retarget only.

name: scan page tier: an email-only manual/moderator grant is premium (C1 repro) — the nav classification's id-only lookup would have called this user free
rationale: R. Dependency emits allowed only on exact `grant@example.com`; exact recorded `[user-1, grant@example.com, false]` plus premium retained. This protects argument delivery and allowed mapping. The already removed bare allowed test is not recredited.

name: scan page tier: a field-test guest is passed through to the paid-access composite
rationale: R. Actual metadata discriminator produces true at paid-composite call. Output is deliberately not asserted; do not inflate to a tier/lookup-skip proof. Other tier fixture lacks guest metadata and would not catch dropping the guest signal.

name: scan page tier: fails closed to premium (never free) when the paid-access composite is unavailable
rationale: R. Resolved `unavailable` reaches this owner's special return, not the outer composed exception path. Removing it derives free from false; thrown-error composition and flag-off bypass keep passing.

name: scan page tier: no authenticated user is premium (never free)
rationale: R. Null user reaches own premium fallback before composite call. Removing fallback rejects while the present-user unavailable callback remains green. It does not independently assert zero composite calls.
